title: Mathematics Reading Room
description: A slow reading group: one chapter or paper at a time, discussed for what it proves and how. Optional, bounded conversations with a chair and at most two classmates.
cadence: After any analysis or geometry tutorial, when invited

title: Physics Colloquium
description: Short talks on one idea in physics and the questions it raises, followed by a bounded discussion. No new material is introduced before the course releases it.
cadence: After a physics unit is completed, when invited

title: Cognitive Science Journal Club
description: One paper or chapter, read for its claims, its evidence and the gap between them.
cadence: After a cognitive science or neuroscience unit, when invited

title: Recreational Problem Circle
description: Problems chosen for pleasure rather than syllabus. Attempts are kept in your notebook if you want them; nothing here is assessed.
cadence: Any time from the common room
